subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: "Where is my son?" said the grocer. "A crow carried your son away," said the fruit seller. "You liar, how can s crow carry such a big boy?" "Just the same way as mice can eat the balance and weights."
guide_solution: The grocer asked the fruitseller where his son was. The fruitseller replied that a crow had carried his son away. Addressing him (F) as a lair, the grocer asked how a crow could carry such a big boy. The fruitseller replied that it was just the same way as mice could eat away the balance and weights.
